source.oag_report: Auditor Generals Summary Report On County Governments 2023 2024

metadata.description: Extracted project and financial performance data from the Kenya OAG County Governments Audit Summary Report and COB Green Book for FY 2023-2024.

project_implementation._description: Project status summaries flagged in the OAG audit report.

delayed_projects_county_executives._description: County Executives with delayed capital projects (Appendix 26). amount_kshs is the value of delayed projects.

stalled_abandoned_projects_county_execut._description: County Executives with stalled or abandoned projects (Appendix 27). amount_kshs is the cumulative value of stalled/abandoned projects.

delayed_projects_county_assemblies._description: County Assemblies with delayed projects (OAG appendix). amount_kshs is the value of delayed projects.

unutilized_assets._description: County Executives with significant unutilized/idle assets flagged during the audit (Appendix 28 area). amount_kshs is the value of the unutilized assets.

data.description: Thirteen Medical machines have remained idle and unused in the stores for over 10 years. Thirty-one (31) vehicles remain unutilzed.
Air conditioning and equipping of the two surgery theatres by the Department of health services were not in use.
Unutilized refrigerated truck which had private registration number
Uninstalled specialized medical equipment at Hola Level 4 Hospital

procurement_irregularities._description: County Executives with procurement irregularities (Appendix 24/25). amount_kshs is the value of irregular procurement spending.

financial_performance._description: County-level financial data from OAG audit appendices.

budget_summary._description: Approved budget allocation for County Executives and Assemblies (Appendix 2, FY 2023-2024).

actual_revenue._description: Actual revenue collected by County Executives and Assemblies (Appendix 3, FY 2023-2024).

own_source_revenue._description: Own-source revenue budget vs actual and % achievement (Appendix 5, FY 2023-2024).

exchequer_releases_vs_receipts._description: National Government exchequer releases versus amounts receipted in County Revenue Funds (Appendix 6).

county_expenditure._description: Total expenditure by County Executives and Assemblies (Appendix 9, FY 2023-2024).

wage_bill_county_executives._description: Personnel emoluments versus total revenue for County Executives (Appendix 10). High values indicate over-spending on salaries.

crf_q4_disbursements_executives._description: Q4 CRF disbursements to County Executives versus total disbursed (Appendix 7). High Q4 % indicates last-minute fund releases.

crf_q4_disbursements_assemblies._description: Q4 CRF disbursements to County Assemblies versus total disbursed (Appendix 8).

voided_transactions_executives._description: IFMIS voided transactions in County Executives (Appendix 19). High counts may indicate internal control weaknesses.

audit_quality._description: OAG audit opinion distribution for FY 2023-2024.

cob_green_book._description: County Executives covered in the COB Green Book (budget estimates FY 2023-2024).
